get_latest_recalls.description: Get the most recent U.S. food recalls from the FDA and USDA, newest first: what was recalled, by whom, why, where it was sold and what to do with it. Up to 20 at a time. No API key required.

recalls.distribution: The recalled product was distributed in New York, Florida, Georgia, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and South Carolina.
recalls.product: Starfish Seafood Trio Because of Possible Health Risk
recalls.reason: Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc. of Brooklyn, New York, is voluntarily recalling Starfish Seafood Trio – Cold Smoked Salmon, Halibut, and Trout, 8 oz (227 g) packages, because the product has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
recalls.recall_class_label: Class I: could cause serious health problems or death
recalls.what_to_do: Do not eat this product. Return it to the place of purchase for a full refund.

get_latest_recalls.name: get_latest_recalls

parameters.description: How many recalls to get, from 1 to 20. All 20 by default.
parameters.name: limit

attribution.description: The credit line to show wherever you publish this data, as the data's CC BY 4.0 licence requires.

count.description: How many recalls are in the list.

feed_date.description: The day the Daily Food Recalls feed was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

recalls.description: The recalls, the most recently started first.

added_on.description: The day Daily Food Recalls first picked the recall up (YYYY-MM-DD).

affected_states.description: Two-letter codes of the states the product was distributed to, e.g. NY. Check nationwide too: a nationwide recall may list no states.

agency.description: The agency that issued the notice: FDA or USDA.

allergens.description: Allergens the recall is about, e.g. Milk or Tree nuts. Empty when the recall is not about an allergen.

brand.description: The brand the product is sold under.

category.description: Food, or Meat & Poultry for USDA recalls.

company.description: The company carrying out the recall.

distribution.description: Where the product went, as the agency describes it.

hazard.description: The problem in a few words, e.g. Listeria or Undeclared milk.

hazard_type.description: The kind of problem: pathogen, allergen, foreign_material, chemical or labeling.

id.description: The recall's ID. Pass it to Get a recall to look this recall up again.

lot_codes.description: Lot codes of the affected product, where given.

nationwide.description: True when the product was distributed nationwide.

official_url.description: Link to the agency's own notice. This is the authoritative version.

page_url.description: Link to the recall's page on Daily Food Recalls.

product.description: The recalled product, as the agency's notice names it.

product_items.description: USDA recalls only: each recalled package, one entry per item, with its size and label. Empty for FDA recalls.

published_on.description: The day the agency published the recall (YYYY-MM-DD). It can be weeks after the start date.

quantity.description: How much product is affected, e.g. 189 pounds, where given.

reason.description: The agency's stated reason for the recall.

recall_class.description: How serious the recall is: 1 is the most serious (could cause serious health problems or death), 3 the least.

recall_class_estimated.description: True when the agency had not yet assigned a class and Daily Food Recalls estimated it from the announcement.

recall_class_label.description: The recall class in words, e.g. 'Class I: could cause serious health problems or death'.

recall_type.description: How the recall came about, e.g. Voluntary: Firm initiated or Public Health Alert.

retailers.description: Stores that sold the product, where the notice names them.

status.description: The recall's status as the agency reports it, e.g. Ongoing.

upc.description: The product's UPC barcode number, where given.

what_to_do.description: Plain-language advice for anyone who has the product.

search_recalls.description: Find current U.S. food recalls by product or brand, by the state they were sold in, by allergen, by kind of hazard, by how serious they are, or by date. Every filter is optional and they combine, so you can ask for, say, Class I recalls sold in Texas since last Monday. Newest first. No API key required.

parameters.description: Words to look for in the product, brand, company, store, UPC or lot code. Every word must appear. Leave it empty to match everything.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only recalls of products sold in any of these states. Nationwide recalls are always included.
parameters.name: states

parameters.description: Only recalls from this agency. The FDA covers most foods; the USDA covers meat, poultry and egg products. Leave it empty for both.
parameters.name: agency

parameters.description: Only recalls for any of these kinds of problem.
parameters.name: hazard_types

options.label: Germs, such as Salmonella, Listeria or E. coli
Foreign objects, such as metal, plastic or glass

parameters.description: Only recalls about any of these allergens, such as milk or peanuts left off the label.
parameters.name: allergens

parameters.description: Only recalls of these classes. Class I is the most serious.
parameters.name: recall_classes

options.label: Class I: could cause serious health problems or death
Class II: could cause temporary or reversible health problems
Class III: unlikely to cause health problems

parameters.description: Only recalls that started on or after this day.
parameters.name: started_on_or_after

parameters.description: Only recalls the agency published on or after this day. Use this to catch new announcements: a recall can be published weeks after it started.
parameters.name: published_on_or_after

parameters.description: The most recalls to return, from 1 to 100. 25 by default.

description: U.S. food recalls from the FDA and USDA in one feed, updated daily. Get the latest recalls, search them by product, brand, state, allergen, hazard or seriousness, and look up one recall's full details with a link to the official notice. No account or API key required.
